crossRefs.note: For he will stand at the right hand of the needy, to save him from those who judge his soul.
But he saves from the sword of their mouth, even the needy from the hand of the mighty.
So the poor has hope, and injustice shuts her mouth.
“I will seek that which was lost, and will bring back that which was driven away, and will bind up that which was…
“Blessed are the poor in spirit, for theirs is the Kingdom of Heaven.
For the Son of Man came to save that which was lost.
Listen, my beloved brothers. Didn’t God choose those who are poor in this world to be rich in faith, and heirs of the…
But you have dishonored the poor man. Don’t the rich oppress you, and personally drag you before the courts?

translations.web: He will have pity on the poor and needy. He will save the souls of the needy.
translations.bsb: He will take pity on the poor and needy and save the lives of the oppressed.
translations.kjv: He shall spare the poor and needy, and shall save the souls of the needy.
translations.asv: He will have pity on the poor and needy, And the souls of the needy he will save.
